question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The division of labour is the second strategy to __**possess money**.__
solution:
The correct answer is **"****to build wealth." **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the phrase **"to possess something" **means to have, earn or own something. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिकार में रखना या उस पर स्‍वामित्‍व होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I want **to possess**__ my home.*
